  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Evaluate and discuss the various types of interactions that may arise in image  
  segmentation tasks.  
  (5)

  (5)  
  A)

  the development and evaluation of medical image analysis algorithms. How do these  
  datasets contribute to benchmarking performance, promoting reproducibility, and             (5)  
  A)      fostering collaboration in the medical imaging research community?  
  
  B)      Generalize and discuss the ethical considerations related to the use of deep learning and  
  AI technologies in medical image analysis. What are the potential risks and benefits of  
  automated diagnosis, patient privacy concerns, and biases in algorithmic decision-        (3)  
  making?  
  
  C)      Interpret whether the following statement is true or false and justify your answer.  
  "Root Mean Square contrast does not differentiate well between different intensity          (2)
